page.overview:
Who is Candace?

Candace, formerly designated TK-90210 during her time in the Galactic Empire, was a human female from the desert planet Tatooine. Candace joined the Empire as a stormtrooper soon after the birth of her brother Phineas Flynn.

In 1 BBY, she was sent to buy a new pair of socks along with Baljeet and Buford by her commanding officer for Darth Vader. However, she got distracted and decided to follow R2-D2 and C-3PO to the planet Tatooine. Later on, she met up with her commanding officer again to be reminded about her mission. She went to Mos Eisley and bought a new pair of socks in the clothing store Tall Darth & Handsome. As she walked out of the building, Candace saw two boys opening up the Death Star plans. Candace then tried chasing the two culprits, though they managed to escape aboard the starship Centennial Chihuahua. Seeing her failed to capture her target, Candace, Baljeet, and Buford went to meet the commanding officer to hand the socks. The socks were stored in a bag that Buford accidentally switched for his bantha cheese hoagie, but they did not realize their mistake until they had left Tatooine to go back to DS-1 Death Star Mobile Battle Station.

She later left the Empire and joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic after reuniting with her brothers.

Years prior to 1 BBY, the human female Candace resided on the desert planet Tatooine alongside her mother Linda Flynn-Fletcher and father. She later left the family not long after the birth of her younger brother Phineas Flynn to enlist as a stormtrooper for the Galactic Empire.
